title: jeb_ Recovery Compass Retexture
description: Adds a secret animated Recovery Compass variant when renamed "jeb_" in an anvil. Inspired by the sheep color cycle, the texture shifts through all colors while preserving directional clarity (red = death location, green = opposite). Small fun easter egg.
body:
When you **rename a Recovery Compass to "jeb_"** in an anvil, it transforms into a **special animated variant** inspired by the classic sheep color cycling mechanic. The compass cycles smoothly through the full color spectrum while in use.

To preserve functionality, the directional indicators remain intact; The side pointing toward your last death location stays red, while the opposite side stays green.

This pack is a small, fun visual twist designed as a nod to the _jeb sheep easter egg that has been in the game since 2013.
